//: Covers src, scripts and test. The other two entries were missing and each was a real hole:
- scripts/ was unreachable from every tsconfig in the repository (this config listed
src/**, and the root config lists only the root scripts/ directory), so the generator
that decides what the committed demo artefacts contain was the one piece of this package
no compiler ever read. Same class of hole scripts/ci.ts documents for scripts/ingest.ts.
- test/ was omitted, which made every other package's convention the exception. It cost
real safety: changing renderReport's options made four call sites in test/cli.test.ts
invalid and `bun run ci:typecheck` stayed green, because tsc was never looking. Every
other package in this workspace typechecks its own tests.
